in_marathi.name: Aryon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryon हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'arya', meaning 'noble', 'honorable'. The name Aryon is associated with the noble Aryan race and holds a rich cultural and historical significance in Hindu mythology.
